issue.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/encode/starlette/discussions/2261
Originally posted by **fernandosilveira** August 31, 2023 Yesterday [`anyio` updated to version `4.0.0`](https://github.com/agronholm/anyio/releases/tag/4.0.0) and starlette [accepts anything `>=3.4.0`](https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/master/pyproject.toml#L31). Apparently, the latest `anyio` no longer has `start_blocking_portal`, thus breaking the test client (e.g., [here](https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/cb6d284877cd359a21a0f31ebf8103a7b285a848/starlette/testclient.py#L416)). I haven't looked deep enough into it but I suppose it's reasonable that `anyio` did not feel obliged to maintain backwards compatibility on a major version upgrade.
> [!IMPORTANT] > - We're using [Polar.sh](https://polar.sh/encode) so you can upvote and help fund this issue. > - We receive the funding once the issue is completed & confirmed by you. > - Thank you in advance for helping prioritize & fund our backlog.
issue.title: Yesterday's update to `anyio` breaks startlette
